On 12/09/2016 06:43 PM, Ruby Ji wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> I am a new one for INLA. I am analyzing a catch data (counts), and
> have developed the INLA model, but don't know how to get prediction
> maps, i.e. the simulated posterior means of catch across the space.
> Since I have five covariates, should I get the their values across the
> space at first?
Yes, you do need the covariates at each prediction point.

Elias
